description: Active category published (PRODUCTION) in the store's catalog listing N..M active products (the PLP 'of N Results'), optionally top level, with at least K active subcategories and short/long descriptions. Source: module guide PIM category-associated-products.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

minProducts.description: Fewest products the category page must list (e.g. more than a page size so a partial page shows)

maxProducts.description: Most products allowed (e.g. the largest page size, so all show on one page). Left out: any

minSubcategories.description: Fewest active published child categories (the nav and PLP subcategory tiles). Left out: any

topLevel.description: Pass true when the test opens the category from the Departments menu (no parent). Left out: any level

withDescriptions.description: Pass true when the test asserts the category's short and long description (both must be set). Left out: any
